newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northwest spot prods notionally unchanged.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northwest spot prods notionally unchanged.

text.p: U.S. Northwest products prices gained little momentum from California markets and continued notionally flat following early-week reports of ample gasoline stocks on the West Coast.
Meanwhile, California products stayed notionally unchanged late Tuesday, as buyers and sellers waited out volatile heating oil prices on NYMEX.
PADD 5 West Coast gasoline stocks rose by 457,000 barrels to 29.6 million barrels last week, according to American Petroleum Institute data released Tuesday.
Supply was 2.3 million barrels over last year.
Regular unleaded gasoline was assessed notionally at 62.50 cents to 63.50 cents a gallon, flat from Tuesday.
Traders heard talk that diesel fuel from ARCO's Cherry Point refinery in Washington state failed to meet quality specificiations.
"They've got some processing problems that are the core of the problem," said one Northwest based trader.
In Seattle, low sulphur diesel stayed 75/76 cents and jet feul remained 76.50/77.50 cents a gallon.
